source_text: Circumcision also lowers risks of inflammatory conditions like balanitis (OR 0.32, 95% CI 0.20-0.52) and pathologic phimosis, which affects up to 10% of uncircumcised boys by adolescence and predisposes to adhesions and infections. [40]
